title: stack/secrets.yaml
description: The secrets manifest (spec §11.5): the provider-neutral list of every secret the stack needs, per zone, as env var name -> logical name. It holds no ids and no values. The local secrets config (secrets-config.schema.json) picks the provider that stores the values under these names. See docs/secrets.md.

archon.description: The Archon container's env file (Pi runs in-process, so it sees these too).

research.description: The hapi-research container's env file: spend-capped, search-only keys (spec §10.1).

host.description: Host tools run by the hapi user (token minting, the harvester). Never a container's env file.

zone.description: Env var name -> logical name. One logical name may fill several env vars.

logicalName.description: A secret's provider-neutral name: hapi- and lowercase words joined by '-'. The store holds the value under this name.
